actualResult: F033 Product defect: CenterCutTargetGenerator.validatePage calls List.copyOf before its explicit null-target validation, so a provider page containing null leaks NullPointerException instead of the maintained IllegalArgumentException validation contract. F034 test harness defect: two valid SpringBatchCenterCutStepHandler paths invoke the production requireSnapshot fail-close boundary without binding the managed parent Context; the mismatch/security tests return before that boundary and therefore pass. Canonical CpfContextTestSupport.bindRoot is available to establish and restore the required test scope without weakening Production.
